name: handle-condition-both-visible-and-not-visible-accepted
description: a handle branch's `when` with both `visible` and `notVisible` set is accepted, unlike a precondition check, because HandleConditionSchema carries no zod refine enforcing exactly one of the two.
yaml:
- launchApp
- handle:
    - when: { visible: "A", notVisible: "B" }
      do:
        - back
    - otherwise: skip
